hero.h1_classes: hero-reveal text-5xl md:text-7xl lg:text-8xl font-medium tracking-tight leading-[0.95] text-white glitch-target mix-blend-difference
hero.cta_classes: bg-transparent border border-black text-black px-8 py-3 rounded-full text-sm font-medium hover:bg-black hover:text-lime-300 transition-all

keyframes_css: @keyframes glitch-anim { 0% { transform: translate(0); text-shadow: none; } 20% { transform: translate(-2px, 1px) skewX(-2deg); text-shadow: 2px 0 rgba(163, 230, 53, 0.3), -2px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3); } 40% { transform: translate(2px, -1px) skewX(2deg); text-shadow: -2px 0 rgba(163, 230, 53, 0.3), 2px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3); } 60% { transform: translate(-1px, 2px); } 100% { transform: translate(0); text-shadow: none; } }
